angle: 쌀쌀해져 창문 닫는 날이 늘면 공기청정기를 오래 틀게 돼요. 최근 'HEPA 필터 물세척 불가' 기사가 나와서 올바른 필터 관리를 다뤄요
title: 필터 수명 늘리는
공기청정기 관리법 8
subtitle: 켜 두기만 하고 필터는 잊으셨죠?
scene: A white floor-standing air purifier placed beside a bright Korean home kitchen, light beige stone countertop, small potted herb and wooden cutting board as props, warm morning sunlight streaming through a window on the left, soft cozy atmosphere, bottom third of frame is plain countertop surface, no text, no faces
cover_image_prompt: The white air purifier stands prominently in the center of the sunny kitchen set, slightly angled toward camera, soft morning light glowing on its surface, clean plain countertop in the lower third, no text, no people

tips.title: 프리필터 2주 청소
tips.note: 물세척 가능 제품만 씻고 그늘에 말리세요
tips.image_prompt: A hand holding a handheld vacuum nozzle against the mesh pre-filter removed from the air purifier, light grey dust visible, on the countertop

tips.title: 헤파필터 솔질
tips.image_prompt: A hand gently brushing the pleated white HEPA filter with a soft dusting brush on the countertop

tips.title: 벽에서 띄우기
tips.image_prompt: The air purifier moved out into open space away from the wall, a measuring tape lying on the floor between purifier and wall

tips.title: 환기 먼저 하기
tips.note: 미세먼지 나쁜 날은 환기를 짧게 하세요
tips.image_prompt: The kitchen window opened wide with a sheer curtain moving in the breeze, air purifier turned off beside it

tips.title: 요리할 땐 후드
lines: 굽고 튀길 땐 후드 먼저 켜요
tips.image_prompt: A frying pan with sizzling vegetables on the stove, light steam rising toward the range hood, air purifier in the background

tips.title: 먼지센서 닦기
lines: 두 달에 한 번 면봉으로 센서 닦기
tips.image_prompt: A hand holding a dry cotton swab near the small sensor opening on the side of the air purifier, unplugged power cord lying on the floor

tips.title: 자동 모드 쓰기
tips.image_prompt: A finger lightly touching the control panel on top of the air purifier, soft glowing indicator light, no readable text

tips.title: 교체 주기 지키기
tips.image_prompt: A new wrapped replacement filter and a used greyish filter side by side on the countertop next to the air purifier

warning.title: 헤파필터 물세척 금지
lines: 젖으면 섬유 구조가 망가져 못 써요
warning.image_prompt: A HEPA filter placed next to the kitchen sink under a running faucet and a spray bottle of air freshener beside it on the countertop

caption:
공기청정기 헤파필터, 저도 예전엔 물로 씻을 뻔했어요 😅
창문 닫는 날이 늘면 공기청정기가 하루 종일 돌아가죠.
프리필터는 2주마다 먼지 털고, 헤파필터는 물 대신 솔로 살살.
벽에서 30cm 띄우고, 요리할 땐 후드 먼저 켜 주세요.
센서는 플러그 뽑고 면봉으로, 교체는 설명서 주기대로요.
여러분 집 공기청정기 필터, 마지막으로 언제 보셨어요?
